Planet Name Generator

Generate sci-fi planet names — Greek-inspired names plus star-catalog designations like Kepler-452b.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a style.
  2. Press Generate Planet Names.
  3. Click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What naming styles are there?

Two styles: Mythic (Greek-inspired names like 'Zephyria') and Catalog (Kepler-452b style designations).

How many names per click?

10 names per click, all unique in the batch.

How do I copy a name?

Click any name to copy it.
